info.title: Fleet Management API
info.description:
Manage vehicles enrolled in bypass and/or tolling services. Add, update or delete vehicles. Assign or request transponders.
*Note: Do not use this API to update tractors enrolled in Toll Violation Prevention Program (VPP) or for trailer plates.*

get.description: Query for one vehicle by VIN or Vehicle Number, or for multiple vehicles by PrePass Account Number or Cost Center.

parameters.name: costCenter
parameters.description: Customer-defined organization ID or code (e.g. location number or expense center).   Note: Either an Account Number or a Cost Center is required.

parameters.name: accountNumber
parameters.description: PrePass Account Number.   Note: Either an Account Number or a Cost Center is required.

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: Vehicle Identification Number - unique alphanumeric code assigned to vehicle.

parameters.name: vehicleNumber
parameters.description: Customer-assigned vehicle number (maxlength = 8).

parameters.name: costCenter
parameters.description: Customer-defined organization ID or code (e.g. location number or expense center).  Edit vehicle attributes by passing the current Cost Center.  Assign a VIN to another Cost Center by passing that Cost Center.  Note: Either an Account Number or a Cost Center is required.

post.description: Order transponders for specified vehicles.  PrePass assigns transponders to vehicles during fulfillment.  UPS Ground is the default shipping method.  If you require expedited shipping, please call PrePass at 800-773-7277.

get.description:
Retrieve the accounts related to the calling user's claims.
>**This `/accounts` endpoint is deprecated and will be retired soon. Please update your integrations to the [latest version here](/api-details#api=prepassapim-account-api-v1).**

200.description: Retrieve accounts associated to the calling user's account claims
